[b][size=xx-large][color=#ffffff]🎃 [u]Hack Forum News - Edition 71 - Halloween Special[/u] 🎃[/color][/size][/b]

[b]Welcome back to another Hack Forum News edition. Where we keep you up to date on the weekly events and news happening on site and around the world. If you have never heard of the Hack Forum News, don't worry, we have you covered. We are a team of members from the Hack Forums community who are journalists and writers, and we are here to keep you in the loop of the changes around the site and the events happening around the world.[/b]

[hr]

[img]https://hackforums.net/images/hfnews/special.png[/img]
[size=medium][b]Writer -[/b][/size] [mention=2331053]

Welcome everyone to our special edition for Halloween 2026. We know a lot of you are thinking "oh no" but trust us on this one. We know its halloween just yet but as our next eiditon is just after this is our special edition for Halloween 2026.

The spooky season is upon us once again! Pumpkins are being carved, costumes are coming out of storage, and somebody has already eaten the entire bag of Halloween sweets.

This year, Halloween falls on [b]Saturday, 31 October[/b], giving everyone the perfect excuse to enjoy a full night of spooky celebrations!

[hr]

[size=x-large][b][color=orange]👻 Spooky Season Goes Digital[/color][/b][/size]

From horror games and creepy internet mysteries to haunted attractions and Halloween parties, there's something for everyone. Whether you're heading out with friends or staying home for a night of gaming, Halloween is the perfect time to embrace the weird and wonderful. Of course, the internet has its own horrors. Suspicious downloads, forgotten passwords and questionable links can be scarier than any ghost.

[size=x-large][b][color=orange]🎮 Costumes, Games and Chaos[/color][/b][/size]

Halloween wouldn't be complete without costumes. Whether you're dressing as a vampire, a terrifying monster or simply throwing on a black hoodie and calling yourself a hacker, creativity is what counts.

For gamers, it's the perfect opportunity to explore spooky maps, play horror games with friends and spend the evening screaming at things that definitely weren't behind you a second ago.

[size=x-large][b][color=orange]🍬 Trick, Treat or Retreat?[/color][/b][/size]

Whether you're going trick or treating, attending a party or staying home with a horror marathon, remember to stay safe, respect others and, most importantly, don't be the person who takes all the sweets.

[hr]
[size=x-large][b][color=orange]🦇 Happy Halloween from HF News Team! 🦇[/color][/b][/size]

Whatever your plans, we hope Halloween 2026 brings plenty of laughs, scares and memorable moments.
Keep it spooky, stay safe, and remember, not every monster lives under the bed. Some are lurking in your downloads folder.

👻 [b]Happy Halloween, Hack Forums![/b] 🎃

[hr]

[img]https://hackforums.net/images/hfnews/headlines-red.png[/img]
[size=medium][b]Writer -[/b][/size] [mention=2745296]

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6334597][color=#ffffff]Notifications Reset[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

If you rely on push notifications across the site you will need to head into your settings and toggle them back on. Following an accidental deletion [mention=1] had to rebuild the configs for Notify, Convo, Plisio, and Stripe from the ground up. Because fresh VAPID keys had to be generated, all existing push tokens had to be reset. Have you re enabled your notifications in your settings yet and is everything working properly on your end?

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6334616][color=#ffffff]AI in Convo[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

[mention=1] is considering adding an AI feature directly into Convo through a dedicated Stanley command. Unlike previous setups where members had to connect their own personal API tokens to interact the proposed integration would run off a site API key. Would you like to see Stanley integrated into Convo and do you have any recommendations for cheap models or providers? Share your thoughts and feedback in the original thread.

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6334613][color=#ffffff]APIv3 Development[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

Due to lingering bugs with the current API, [mention=1] has announced plans to rebuild the forum API completely from scratch as soon as possible. Developers and members relying on the service should prepare ahead of time as APIv2 will be fully deprecated within 30 days once the brand new build goes live. Do you actively use the forum API for any projects or tools and what improvements are you hoping to see in the new version?

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]AI discovers serious security flaws in PHP[/color][/size][/b][/u]

[b][url=Security researchers used AI tools to uncover critical vulnerabilities in PHP, software that powers a substantial portion of websites.]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]Google pushes AI further into cars[/color][/size][/b][/u]

Google is working on a more personalised version of its Gemini assistant for use in cars. The development was reported on 20 October. The broader direction is to make in car assistants more conversational and useful than traditional voice commands. That could mean more natural conversations, help with navigation and better integration with services.

[b][url=https://techcrunch.com/2026%2F10%2F20]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]Nvidia faces huge demand for AI hardware in China[/color][/size][/b][/u]

Chinese technology companies, including ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent, had placed orders worth more than $35 billion for Nvidia RTX PRO 5500 workstation graphics cards.

[b][url=https://www.reuters.com/business/retail-consumer/bytedance-alibaba-tencent-place-over-35-billion-worth-nvidia-chip-orders-2026-10-20]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]Is the oversupply coming?[/color][/size][/b][/u]

Industry reporting in 2026 has pointed to an important distinction. DRAM shortages could persist, while NAND flash may move towards a more balanced market and eventually oversupply. These are forecasts, not guarantees of future retail prices.

[b][url=https://www.techtimes.com/articles/322399/20260731/dram-buyers-face-two-more-years-scarcity-nand-tilts-toward-surplus.html]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]Tesla and SpaceX consider a potential merger[/color][/size][/b][/u]

Tesla and SpaceX had formed special committees to review a potential merger. A potential combination would raise questions about how their technologies, operations and financial resources might be brought together. We have only just seen last week the release of the flying car they claim will be in production in just a few years.

[b][url=https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/20/spacex-and-tesla-boards-form-special-committees-to-review-merger/]Source[/url][/b]

[align=center][img]https://hackforums.net/images/hfnews/ves-brown.png[/img]
[size=medium][b]Writer -[/b][/size] [mention=5458992]

[color=#C10300][b][size=15]Never Stop Growing[/size][/b][/color]

Life is a journey filled with unexpected turns, difficult lessons, and moments that challenge everything we thought we knew. Sometimes, we find ourselves standing in places we never imagined, wondering whether we're making any real progress.

But growth doesn't always happen in ways we can see. Sometimes, it happens in silence—in the lessons we learn from disappointment, the patience we develop through hardship, and the courage we discover when life pushes us beyond our comfort zone.

Don't compare your journey to someone else's. Everyone moves at a different pace, faces different struggles, and carries different burdens. What matters is not how quickly you reach your destination, but how much you learn along the way.

Give yourself permission to make mistakes. Give yourself time to heal. Give yourself credit for the progress you've made, even when it feels small.

You may not be where you want to be yet, but that doesn't mean you're standing still. Every day offers another opportunity to become wiser, stronger, and better than you were yesterday.

Keep learning. Keep improving. Keep believing that the best version of yourself is still ahead.
[hr]

[color=#FF851B][size=15]Advice of the week[/size][/color]

Stop putting pressure on yourself to have everything figured out. Focus on taking one meaningful step at a time. Progress is progress, no matter how small it seems.

[hr]

[color=#008E02][size=15]Quote of the week[/size][/color]

“Great things are done by a series of small things brought together.”

- Vincent van Gogh
